from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Hook(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., title='Name')
    callback: Callable[[int], int] = Field(
        ...,
        json_schema_extra={'x-python-type': 'Callable[[int], int]'},
        title='Callback',
    )


class Inner(BaseModel):
    callback: Callable[[int], int] = Field(
        ...,
        json_schema_extra={'x-python-type': 'Callable[[int], int]'},
        title='Callback',
    )


class Outer(BaseModel):
    inner: Inner
    hooks: list[Hook] = Field(..., title='Hooks')
    fallback: Callable[[int], int] | None = Field(None, title='Fallback')


class Deep(BaseModel):
    outer: Outer
